list.name: peer
list.label: Viewer
list.description: For the per-viewer panels of the BWE row

panels.title: Producers
panels.description: Includes pipe producers between workers

panels.title: Consumers
panels.description: Includes pipe consumers between workers

panels.title: Busiest worker CPU
panels.description: A worker is one thread on one core: at ~100% it starts dropping/delaying packets

panels.title: Consumer score avg
panels.description: mediasoup's 0..10 score over a random consumer sample (10 = no loss)

panels.title: Workers (one mediasoup-worker process per pinned core)
Worker CPU % (per worker)
panels.description: user+sys from /proc. Softirq for this core is not included — see the SFU dashboard

panels.title: Worker CPU: max / avg / min
panels.description: A wide max-avg gap means placement is unbalanced: one worker saturates while others idle

panels.title: Consumer imbalance (max / avg)
panels.description: 1.0 = perfectly balanced

panels.title: CPU per consumer (µs of worker CPU per consumer-second)
panels.description: Efficiency: should stay flat as load grows. Rising = per-packet overhead growing (cache, pipes, NACK storms)

panels.title: Pipes created (pipeToRouter)
panels.description: A room that outgrows one router gets piped to another worker

panels.title: ICE / DTLS state changes
panels.description: disconnected/failed/closed while load is steady = transports dying

panels.title: BWE vs link (media.yaml bwe_telemetry: true; profile/peer from the loadgen)
Estimate, sent and link limit — $peer
panels.description: est = mediasoup's send-side estimate for this viewer (bwe trace, ~100 ms updates, scraped every 5 s); sent = all bytes to the viewer incl. RTX, probes, RTCP; limit = the generator's downlink shaper (dippy: only during dips)

panels.title: Forwarded spatial layer — $peer
panels.description: Lowest spatial layer over the viewer's video consumers; -1 = no video forwarded

panels.title: Estimate ÷ limit by profile
panels.description: Across the profile's viewers while a limit applies. > 1: the estimate is above what the link carries

targets.expr: quantile by (profile) (0.5, mediasoup_peer_bwe_available_bps / on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_link_bps{profile=~"$profile"})
quantile by (profile) (0.95, mediasoup_peer_bwe_available_bps / on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_link_bps{profile=~"$profile"})

panels.title: Sent ÷ limit by profile
panels.description: Averaged over $__rate_interval, so short bursts above the limit are hidden: see scripts/bwe_analyze.py for 1 s resolution

targets.expr: 100 * avg by (profile) ((mediasoup_peer_bwe_available_bps / on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_link_bps{profile=~"$profile"}) > bool 1)

panels.title: Estimate by profile (all viewers)
panels.description: Includes clean and loss/delay-only profiles: their estimate should stay high

targets.expr: quantile by (profile) (0.05, mediasoup_peer_bwe_available_bps * on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_info{profile=~"$profile"})
quantile by (profile) (0.5, mediasoup_peer_bwe_available_bps * on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_info{profile=~"$profile"})

panels.title: RTX and probe share of bytes sent

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (profile) (rate(mediasoup_peer_sent_bytes_total{kind="rtx"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_info{profile=~"$profile"}) / sum by (profile) (rate(mediasoup_peer_sent_bytes_total{kind="all"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_info{profile=~"$profile"})

100 * sum by (profile) (rate(mediasoup_peer_sent_bytes_total{kind="probation"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_info{profile=~"$profile"}) / sum by (profile) (rate(mediasoup_peer_sent_bytes_total{kind="all"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_info{profile=~"$profile"})

panels.title: Viewers on the top layer
panels.description: Of viewers with video forwarded; top = the highest layer any viewer gets now

targets.expr: 100 * avg by (profile) (((mediasoup_peer_video_layer * on(peer) group_left(profile) bench_peer_info{profile=~"$profile"}) >= 0) == bool scalar(max(mediasoup_peer_video_layer)))

panels.title: BWE trace events
panels.description: Sanity: ~10/s per viewer with video. 0 = bwe_telemetry off

panels.title: Media RPC latency p95 by method
Signaling request latency p95 by method
panels.description: Client request → reply, including the media RPC

panels.title: Signaling → media RPC p95 by method
panels.description: Compare with media-side RPC latency: the gap is HTTP/queueing between the two processes

panels.title: Signaling errors
panels.description: Must stay 0

panels.title: Node CPU (cores)
panels.description: Single-threaded: ~1 core = control plane saturated (joins/RPC queue up)

panels.title: GC time per second by kind
